class.name: DebugMenu
class.brief_description: Native in-game performance and hardware debug menu.
class.description: Engine singleton that owns the native debug menu overlay. In a normal project run the overlay is created automatically on the first frame and toggled with the [code]cycle_debug_menu[/code] input action (F3 by default). No autoload, scene or script is required. The overlay shows FPS, frame time, CPU/GPU frame times, graphs, hardware information and the active rendering settings, matching the debug menu add-on. The overlay is not created in the editor UI, the project manager, headless runs or release templates unless [code]debug_menu/enabled[/code] is set. Changing [member style] or [member visible] installs it on demand.

method.name: cycle_style
method.description: Advances to the next style: [constant HIDDEN], [constant VISIBLE_COMPACT], [constant VISIBLE_DETAILED] and back to [constant HIDDEN].

method.name: get_overlay
method.description: Returns the live overlay node, or [code]null[/code] when the overlay is not installed.

method.name: get_recording_path
method.description: Returns the CSV path used by [method set_recording_enabled].

method.name: get_stats
method.description: Returns the current measurements and derived statistics. Keys: [code]fps[/code], [code]frametime_ms[/code], [code]frametime_avg_ms[/code], [code]frametime_min_ms[/code], [code]frametime_max_ms[/code], [code]cpu_ms[/code], [code]cpu_avg_ms[/code], [code]cpu_min_ms[/code], [code]cpu_max_ms[/code], [code]gpu_ms[/code], [code]gpu_avg_ms[/code], [code]gpu_min_ms[/code], [code]gpu_max_ms[/code], [code]frame[/code], [code]history_frames[/code], [code]p99_frametime_ms[/code], [code]p999_frametime_ms[/code], [code]low_1pct_fps[/code], [code]low_0_1pct_fps[/code] and [code]gpu_timing_available[/code].

method.name: install
method.description: Installs the overlay now if it is enabled and the game is not running in the editor, project manager or headless mode. Safe to call repeatedly.

method.name: is_installed
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while the overlay node exists.

method.name: is_visible
method.description: Returns whether the overlay is currently shown.

method.name: is_recording_enabled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while frames are being written to the CSV log.

method.name: reset_history
method.description: Clears the frame history and refills it with the current values so the graphs start flat.

method.name: set_recording_enabled
method.description: Starts or stops the CSV frame log at [code]debug_menu/recording/path[/code].

method.name: set_style
method.description: Sets the display style and emits [signal style_changed].

method.name: set_visible
method.description: Shows or hides the overlay without changing its style. Showing it installs the overlay if needed.

method.name: uninstall
method.description: Removes the overlay and its performance monitors.

method.name: update_settings_label
method.description: Rebuilds the rendering-settings block. Call it after changing graphics settings at runtime; window resizes refresh it automatically.

members.member: Whether the overlay is currently shown.

signal.name: style_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the display style changes, including when the toggle action is used.

constants.constant: Only FPS, frame time and the frame counter are shown.
Everything is shown, including the graphs and the information blocks.
